items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Quinten Jackson in a hypothetical scenario ('maybe after Quinten Jackson...'), but the interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not respond with any personal anecdote, memory, or statement indicating a direct relationship with Quinten Jackson.

ctx.x: Well not too many people were then, you know, because I know Cab used to say, now the trumpet players in the band idolized Dizzy for what he was doing, but Cab there when Diz was with Cab you know, he'd get up there and Cab couldn't dig him too well, you know, he's up there playing. And then a lot of times maybe another trumpet player, Shad Collins or Jonah would come up and play a solo

maybe after Quinten Jackson or one of them and come up and they would be influenced by Dizzy a little, and Cab would look at them, look at Jonah and say oh man, you too, have you gone on that wagon too? And not too many but look what he is today.
Do you remember the night that Dizzy got fired?
